title: Console Beacon Switchboard — information architecture proposal for nav, workspace switching, and cost lenses
creator: Sofie Nguyen
description:
Problem: The current Console navigation mixes global product surfaces (dashboards, rollouts, billing) with workspace-level routes, causing cognitive load for multi-workspace users and hiding cost signals that are important during rollouts.

Goal: Propose a new information architecture (IA) and sidebar pattern called the "Beacon Switchboard" that: 1) surfaces workspace context clearly, 2) exposes lightweight cost lenses and rollout controls without modal hopping, and 3) preserves fast access to per-route observability (latency/cost/error) for owners.

Scope: IA + sidebar composition, primary/secondary routing rules, workspace switcher microflow, compact cost lens UI (token and embedding breakdown), rollout quick-actions (canary, promote, rollback), accessibility guidelines, and a mid-fidelity prototype for validation. Not in scope: backend permission model changes (tracked separately in ENG-4210) and Dedicated/private deployment network settings.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Mid-fidelity prototype clickable for the primary flows: switch workspace, open cost lens, open rollout quick-actions, and drill into per-route metrics.
2) Usability benchmark: median success task completion >= 90% and median time-on-task reduced by 30% vs baseline for switching and locating cost info.
3) Engineering checklist with known constraints and fallback behaviors documented (token refresh, websocket handoff, route aliasing).
4) Accessibility pass: keyboard navigation + screen reader labels for workspace list and cost lenses.
design_notes:
Core concepts: Beacon (persistent contextual indicator at top-left showing workspace + quick cost snapshot), Switchboard (collapsible rail with primary surfaces and contextual plugs for rollouts/dashboards), and Lenses (compact overlays for cost/latency that persist across routes).

- Beacon: shows workspace name, role badge, and two micro-metrics (30d cost est, 1h P90 latency) with tooltips. Tapping expands workspace actions.
- Switchboard: prioritized items (Overview, Models, Routes, Rollouts, Metrics, Settings) with contextual badges (e.g., active canary). Secondary items collapse under a "More" affordance.
- Workspace switcher: combined search + recent + pinned; switching uses a soft-handoff to avoid losing open editors (prompt if unsaved changes). We propose a deferred switch (switch preview) so users can open another workspace in a new tab.
- Cost Lenses: quick token/embedding cost breakdown, estimated per-route spend, and a suggested optimization tip (e.g., enable prefix caching, reduce max_tokens) with an action to create an Optimize experiment.
comments: 2026-02-23 — Sofie Nguyen: Initial IA sketch completed. Shared with PM and Eng for feasibility call. Focused on minimizing clicks for rollout operations.
2026-02-26 — Miguel Ortega (PM): Liked the Beacon micro-metrics; requested including per-route cost deltas for rollouts so PMs can see impact immediately. Added PM-331 as dependency.

2026-03-02 — Lea Park (Eng): Raised a concern about workspace switch handoff when long-lived websocket sessions exist (token swap). Suggested adding a soft-handoff flow to avoid dropped connections. Assigned ENG-4210 to surface server-side requirements.
2026-03-04 — Accessibility review (Rory Chen): Keyboard order for switcher needs refinement; recommended aria-activedescendant for search results and explicit aria-labels for cost chips.

2026-03-07 — Asha Kapoor (Design): Mid-fidelity updated: added compact 'cost sparkline' and an inline 'suggested action' CTA that opens Optimize wizard. Shared prototype with two customer success managers for quick feedback.

2026-03-09 — CS feedback (Harper Lin): Preview mode is valuable. Suggested pinning low-traffic workspaces to a 'favorites' zone to reduce noise. Noted customers in finance want CSV export for cost lens.
2026-03-10 — Design review: Ready for moderated usability tests. Next: schedule 6 sessions (mix of PMs, infra engineers, real customers) and capture task completion/time.
next_steps: 1) Run moderated usability tests (6 sessions) and synthesize findings (owner: Asha). 2) Finalize accessibility adjustments and deliver a dev-ready Figma file. 3) Create engineering RFC with ENG-4210 to define token handoff and route aliasing behavior. 4) Prepare a canary rollout plan for console-2026.04 with A/B gating for the Beacon affordance.
qa_checklist:
- Prototype flows verify: workspace switch, cost lens, rollout quick-actions.
- Keyboard nav works for all controls.
- Cost numbers match Grafana sample dashboards (linked).
- No hidden modal dialogs that prevent contextual quick-actions.
notes_for_engineering: Important engineering constraints: avoid full page reload on workspace switch when possible; support a 'preview' API that returns route map + permissions for target workspace; provide hooks for ephemeral credential exchange during handoff. If impossible, document fallback UX. Also include a telemetry event design (workspace_switch_started, workspace_switch_completed, cost_lens_opened, rollout_triggered).
final_decision: Pending usability test results. Current direction approved for prototype-to-RFC handoff. PM requested cost deltas inclusion before engineering implementation.
